svg.text: All 45 artist-editable SVGs promoted as Terrarium production sources · automatic prop styling disabled
Plan-projected work surfaces and the small items that establish their use.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse desk
svg.desc: Plan-projected molded-plastic office desk with inset writing surface, monitor, keyboard, papers, and mug.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse desk lamp
svg.desc: Elevation-projected molded task lamp with a broad hood, service stem, weighted base, warm glow, and coral switch.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse standing desk
svg.desc: Plan-projected molded standing desk with a rear equipment rail, inset writing surface, lift-control pod, keyboard, and mug.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional coffee table
svg.desc: Plan-projected low molded tray table with magazines, mug, tiny plant, and a recessed front service edge.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse conference table
svg.desc: Plan-projected capsule conference table with compact molded chairs and a central cable and service spine.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse reception desk
svg.desc: Plan-projected molded reception counter with a continuous public ledge, operator return, monitor, bell, and service control.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse desk clutter
svg.desc: Plan-projected organized paperwork island with an inset tray, paper stacks, telephone, mug, and front organizer rail.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse cubicle workstation
svg.desc: Plan-projected one-person cubicle with a continuous molded privacy shell, inset desk, compact bucket chair, papers, and mug.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional break table
svg.desc: Plan-projected washable round meal table with tucked molded stools and a central service caddy.

svg.text: Seating, storage, shelving, and freestanding furnishing shells.

svg.title: QuotaCo catalog bookshelf
svg.desc: Elevation-projected molded reference bookshelf with a dark catalog bay, literal books, employee plant, service tab, and grounded plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo employee lockers
svg.desc: Elevation-projected molded locker bank with repeated labeled doors, vents, coral handles, and a grounded plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo open supply shelving
svg.desc: Elevation-projected open molded rack with structural uprights, shelf lips, removable labeled catalog bins, and a coral service marker.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional waiting bench
svg.desc: Plan-projected full-span catalog bench with a molded beam, individually readable seat inserts, and service tab.

svg.title: QuotaCo pantry shelf
svg.desc: Elevation-projected washable pantry shell with food packages, mugs, shelf lips, service tab, and grounded plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo wipe-clean beanbag
svg.desc: Plan-projected squashed floor pod with stitched upholstery panels, sat-in dent, carry tab, and maintenance marker.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional nap pod
svg.desc: Elevation-projected recovery pod with a molded base, visible mattress and blanket, pillow, foot controls, and retractable clamshell privacy visor.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse office chair
svg.desc: Plan-projected rolling office chair with a dominant seat and three tucked caster contacts.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse filing cabinet
svg.desc: Elevation-projected rounded filing cabinet with four labeled drawers and a grounded plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse supply cabinet
svg.desc: Elevation-projected molded supply cabinet with a catalog bay, labeled double doors, coral handles, and grounded plinth.

svg.title: QuotaCo compact coat rack
svg.desc: Elevation-projected molded coat rack with a compact post, horizontal hook crown, coral hook tips, one employee coat, and stable base.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional lobby couch
svg.desc: Plan-projected full-span molded couch with replaceable cushion inserts, service tab, and clear arm shells.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional lounge seating
svg.desc: Plan-projected conversation set with modular molded bucket seats around a legible shared low table.

svg.text: Amenities, appliances, processing equipment, IRIS equipment, and service infrastructure.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system water cooler
svg.desc: Elevation water cooler with a compact bottle cowl and a waist-height hot and cold service console.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system printer
svg.desc: Elevation printer with a molded paper path, visible feed and output bays, and a protected control pod.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system coffee machine
svg.desc: Elevation coffee machine with a molded brew tower and protected cup interaction bay.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system printer jammed state
svg.desc: The accepted printer shell with a torn feed sheet and explicit red service-state control.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system coffee machine broken state
svg.desc: The accepted coffee-machine shell with a cracked carafe, leak, and red service-state marker.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system water cooler empty state
svg.desc: The accepted water-cooler shell with a drained bottle and explicit out-of-service marker.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse copier
svg.desc: Elevation-projected floor copier with scanner lid, controls, output mouth, paper drawers, and base.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system paper shredder
svg.desc: Elevation paper shredder with a broad intake visor, visible feed slot, and legible collection bin.

svg.title: QuotaCo open server rack
svg.desc: Elevation-projected technical rack with exposed mounting rails, repeated horizontal server units, top cooling fans, status lamps, cable spine, and grounded base.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system microwave
svg.desc: Elevation counter microwave with a washable molded shell, dark door, and protected control pod.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system break-room fridge
svg.desc: Elevation institutional refrigerator softened by employee notes, magnets, and coral service handles.

svg.title: QuotaCo service-system vending machine
svg.desc: Elevation vending machine with a catalog window, explicit payment spine, and broad retrieval bay.

svg.title: QuotaCo mail sorting station
svg.desc: Elevation-projected broad mail station with an open pigeonhole matrix, visible envelopes, projecting sorting shelf, paired parcel bays, and grounded plinth.

svg.text: Wall-slot architecture plus office-softening plants, graphics, light, and display pieces.

svg.title: QuotaCo workhorse office plant
svg.desc: Elevation-projected organic office plant in a molded institutional planter.

svg.title: QuotaCo catalog potted tree
svg.desc: Elevation-projected umbrella-canopy tree in a molded service planter with an employee care label.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary foliage, secondary catalog bay, accent service tab. Default height 90 and fullness 2.

svg.title: QuotaCo wall-rail hanging plant
svg.desc: Plan-authored wall-slot planter capsule with catalog mounting rail and individually editable trailing vines.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary foliage, secondary catalog rail, accent service tab. Default trail 24 and fullness 2.

svg.title: QuotaCo institutional floor lamp
svg.desc: Elevation-projected local task lamp with molded base, arched service standard, and broad warm shade.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary molded shell, secondary service standard, accent control tab. Default height 92.

svg.title: QuotaCo catalog-framed employee art
svg.desc: Plan-authored wall-slot landscape art with a deep molded frame, green inset, generous paper mat, and three editable scenes.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary molded frame, secondary inset and landscape, accent service tab. Default width 36 and scene 1.

svg.title: QuotaCo employee poster rail
svg.desc: Plan-authored wall-slot poster with a molded clip rail, loose curled paper, bold graphic, and editable caption count.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary clip rail, secondary graphic, accent service tab and sun. Default caption lines 2.

svg.title: QuotaCo wall clock
svg.desc: Plan-authored wall-slot clock with a rounded service backplate, circular paper face, readable ticks, and editable hour hand.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary molded housing, secondary service backplate, accent service tab and hand hub. Default hour 10.

svg.title: QuotaCo employee fish tank
svg.desc: Elevation-projected wide aquarium vessel overhanging a narrower molded service stand, with visible water, gravel, plants, bubbles, and editable fish.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary molded caps and stand, secondary aquarium frame and service bay, accent access controls. Default fish count 3.

svg.title: QuotaCo employee string lights
svg.desc: Plan-authored wall-slot string lights with molded mounting clips, a dark sagging cable, and four to eight editable warm bulbs.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary mounting clips, secondary cable inserts, accent service end. Default bulb count 6.

svg.title: QuotaCo repaired office rug
svg.desc: Plan-projected soft area rug with broad institutional bands, employee personalization, and a visible repair patch.
svg.metadata: Palette tokens: primary outer mat, secondary field, accent central mark and repair. Default width 96 and pattern 1.
